preamble: The shift from the open central vowel [a] to the open-mid back unrounded vowel [ʌ] (the caret) is typically a result of vowel reduction in unstressed positions or systemic dialectal backing and raising.

examples.note: Superscript digits are Marchese Zogbo's tone levels; the reconstruction rests on Dida, Neyo, Guibéroua and Daloa Bété forms.
Marchese Zogbo finds few conditioning factors; Godié keeps peripheral /a/ alongside the new central vowel /ʌ/.

sources: Jones, D., & Ward, D. (1969). The Phonetics of Russian. Cambridge University Press. https://www.cambridge.org/9780521067362
Marchese Zogbo, L. (2019). Central vowels in the Kru language family: Innovation and areal spreading. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3367199
